sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Lessons"."staff_id" AS e, "Addresses"."state_province_county" AS g, SUM("Lessons"."price") AS m1 FROM "Lessons" JOIN "Staff" ON "Staff"."staff_id" = "Lessons"."staff_id" JOIN "Addresses" ON "Addresses"."address_id" = "Staff"."staff_address_id" GROUP BY "Lessons"."staff_id", "Addresses"."state_province_county"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
